doppelganger.title: Doppelganger
doppelganger.description: Unlocks Doppelganger (1 mana per second while summoned) on the ability wheel
doppelganger.extra_description: Summons a double of yourself that fights beside you and copies your attacks. Tap again while looking at an enemy to send the double behind it; hold for 2 seconds to swap places with the double; sneak and cast to dismiss it.

blackout.title: Blackout
blackout.description: Unlocks Blackout (Level 1) (60 mana, 180 s cooldown) on the ability wheel. Hold the Ponder key (W) here to preview it
